gallery.opfGapNote: OPF v1 has no image filter tokens. The OPF Config keeps a faded photo background (image background opacity) with a two-tone color scheme; the duotone recolor needs a schema extension. PPTX export writes the faded photo as a native background picture fill with the opacity as alpha.
